Claire — thanks for the note. Attached is a compact MAP snapshot (pilot-MAP-v1.xlsx) with the items you requested. Below is the condensed checkpoint for your tracker.

Weekly checkpoint cadence:
- Standing sync: Tuesdays 10:00 PT (30 min) — short status + blockers.
- Deep technical sync: Thursdays 1:00 PT (60 min) — runbooks, test results, infra tweaks.

Current evaluation plan (summary):
- Objective: Validate inference latency, p95 < 250ms at target concurrency, and end-to-end throughput for 2k daily requests.
- Tests: synthetic latency runs, replayed prod-ish traces, and 5 curated user prompts for quality regression.
- Acceptance checks: see bullets below.

Acceptance criteria (pass = all must be green):
1) Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms under nominal load (target concurrency = 8).
2) Throughput: sustained 18 tokens/sec per GPU (baseline model) or equivalent cost/latency tradeoff via quantized variant.
3) Quality: automated evals on 5 prompt families — no model-side regressions >5% relative to baseline; human spot-check passes for the same prompt set.
4) Reliability: error rate <0.5% and automatic fallback to smaller model on OOMs.

Known blockers right now:
- Data access: Finera test tenant logs (S3) not yet provisioned to our trial bucket (owner: Alex Gomez, due: 2027-05-14).
- SOC2 evidence request: Finera legal asked for environment diagrams and retention policy (we can provide by EOD Fri if OK).

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Alex (Finera) to grant read-only S3 role to redwood-trial-account — due 2027-05-14.
- Monica (Redwood) to run initial synthetic latency suite and post results to shared Drive — due 2027-05-13.
- Marissa (Redwood) to prepare evaluation harness (5 prompt families + automated scripts) and share runbook — due 2027-05-14.
- Olga (Redwood) to share MAP snapshot and weekly checkpoint invite (attached) — completed.

Attachment: pilot-MAP-v1.xlsx (tab: milestones, owners, acceptance matrix)

If Alex or others on your side prefer a separate onboarding call for S3/RBAC, happy to set it up this week.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
